list.text: I didn’t want to interrupt your Gym Challenge, but...\n I’ve run into something strange here in the lab.
Well, we tried a different type of scan on the Mysterious Ball earlier today...
When I started the machine, the Mysterious Ball reacted with a strong pulse.
It was quiet, but incredibly powerful.\nMy entire system picked it up.
And right after that my sensors began detecting strange readings across the islands.
Pockets of unstable energy.They’re small, but extremely concentrated.
One of those readings just appeared north from Mikan Island.
\PN, can you please go there and investigate it for me?
Mikan Island\nWhere Battles Ride the Waves
Mikan Island Pokémon Gym Leader: Cissy\nThe Expert on Water-type Pokémon
These hot springs are great for relaxing...
The sea around here are full of Pokémon.
The sea around the Orange Islands are beautiful!!
And the Pokémon are even more...
The Gym Leader here is called Cissy.
I've never seen a Gym like this one! It’s like surfing and battling at the same time!
